faq.title: FAQ
faq.lead: Straight answers on how OCMONO works — agency services, SaaS products, and what happens after you book a call.

items.question: What does OCMONO do?
items.answer: Two equal pillars: performance marketing (paid media, SEO & local, conversion creative, funnels) and SaaS products like ClinicPro and MenuBip that operators run daily.

items.question: Can I buy your software without agency work?
items.answer: Yes. Live products have their own sites and pricing. Agency services are optional — use one, the other, or both.

items.question: Which products are live today?
items.answer: ClinicPro (clinicpro.cc) and MenuBip (menubip.com). HotelPro, HRMS, CRM, and LeadStack are on the waitlist.

items.question: Do you only work with healthcare and restaurants?
items.answer: Those are strong verticals via our products, but performance marketing supports any brand that needs measurable demand — leads, bookings, and revenue.

items.question: What happens on a strategy call?
items.answer: We map your goals, current channels, and constraints in about 30 minutes — then recommend the leanest path: agency work, a product, or a combined plan. No pressure pitch.

items.question: How fast can we get started?
items.answer: Product trials can start quickly via each product site. Agency engagements usually kick off within a week of aligning scope — with weekly optimization once live.
